newsItems.title: Goodfire says its new ‘inside-out’ monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost
newsItems.summary: Goodfire just launched what it says is a cheaper way to keep AI agents in check: Instead of paying a second AI to read everything an agent does, its monitors peek inside the model while it works and only call in backup when something looks fishy.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 智能体能否连接工具并稳定完成任务，决定 AI 从回答问题走向交付结果的速度。
newsItems.titleZh: Goodfire表示，其新的“由内而外”监控器只需花费一小部分成本就能捕捉到流氓AI代理
newsItems.summaryZh: Goodfire刚刚推出了一种更便宜的方式来控制人工智能代理：它的监视器不会花费第二个人工智能来读取代理所做的一切，而是在模型工作时偷看模型内部，只有在看起来有问题时才会调用备份。
